full_prompt_en: A vivid folk-art illustration arranges three tall stylized cats beneath a branching garden canopy on a deep red ground. An ochre cat stands at the left, a near-black cat at the center, and a turquoise cat at the right. Their bodies are simplified into upright geometric columns with pointed ears, pale almond eyes, small triangular noses, and thin white whiskers. Each body carries its own ornamental pattern: curling floral lines and stippled dots on the ochre figure, blue-gray leaves on the dark one, and scattered circular motifs and stems on the turquoise one. Overhead, thick charcoal branches arc from the edges and hold teardrop leaves, round fruits, seed shapes, and small flower-like disks in yellow, cream, teal, and rust. These bright decorations fill nearly every gap in the red background, creating a dense but readable tapestry. The black cat's silhouette provides a strong visual anchor between the two brighter side figures. Fine engraved-looking marks and tiny dots add tactile richness to otherwise flat color areas. There is no perspective or shadowed floor; the figures and foliage share a single decorative plane, with overlap supplying only a shallow sense of depth. The saturated red field is balanced by cool turquoise and warm ochre, while cream eyes and dots give a steady visual beat. The whole frame feels playful and ceremonial, like a small painted panel alive with patterned rhythm.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅鲜亮的民艺插画在深红底色上，把三只高而风格化的猫排列于分枝的花园树冠下。左边是赭黄色猫，中央是近黑色猫，右边是青绿色猫。身体被简化为直立的几何柱形，配尖耳、浅色杏眼、小三角鼻和纤细白须。每只猫身上都有不同装饰纹样：赭黄色形体上是卷曲花线与点状纹，深色形体上是蓝灰叶片，青绿色形体上则散有圆形图案与茎叶。上方，粗厚的炭黑枝条从边缘弯入，挂着黄、奶油白、青色和锈色的水滴状叶片、圆果、种子形与小花盘。这些明亮装饰几乎填满红色背景的每个空隙，形成密集但清楚可读的织毯。中央黑猫的剪影成为两侧较亮形体之间强有力的视觉支点。近似雕刻的细线与小小圆点使原本平整的色区具有可触的丰厚感。没有透视或带阴影的地面；人物和枝叶共享一个装饰平面，仅靠重叠产生浅浅纵深。饱和红色区域由冷青绿和暖赭黄平衡，奶油白色眼睛与圆点给画面稳定的节拍。整幅画像一块因纹样节奏而活起来的小彩绘板，俏皮又庄重。
style_prompt_en: The folk-art image uses flat saturated fields of deep vermilion, charcoal, turquoise, ochre, and cream, enriched with tiny stipples and engraved-looking decorative lines. Upright blocky shapes establish a firm central rhythm beneath broad arcing branches. Teardrop forms, circles, fine stems, and pale almond-like accents repeat across the surface at several scales, filling the ground without obscuring the main silhouettes. Each large color area has a distinct internal pattern, so ornament becomes a way of differentiating forms. Outlines are crisp and dark; depth is shallow and produced chiefly by overlap. Illumination is even and graphic, with no realistic cast shadows. Warm red dominates the area, while cooler turquoise and small cream points prevent it from becoming monotonous. The whole frame feels playful, dense, and ceremonial through its tapestry-like arrangement and hand-marked texture.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅民艺图像使用深朱红、炭黑、青绿、赭黄和奶油白的平整饱和色域，并以细小点纹和近似雕刻的装饰线丰富表面。直立而块状的形态在宽阔弯曲的枝线下建立坚定的中央节奏。水滴形、圆形、纤细茎线与浅色杏仁形重点以不同尺度反复出现，填满底色却不遮住主要剪影。每片大色域都有不同内部纹样，因此装饰本身成为区分形体的办法。轮廓清晰而深暗；纵深很浅，主要由重叠产生。照明均匀且图形化，没有写实投影。暖红色占据最大面积，较冷的青绿和细小奶油白点避免单调。整幅画借助织毯般的安排与手工痕迹肌理，显得俏皮、密集而有仪式感。
theme_en: Three patterned cats beneath a red garden canopy
theme_zh: 红色花园树冠下的三只纹样猫
name: Karla Gerard
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
